name: Everardo Wickramasinghe-Delgado-Wickramasinghe

description:
Everardo Wickramasinghe-Delgado-Wickramasinghe is the angriest person in the Lower Dock Crew and possibly in the Gray Zone. He lost three fingers on his right hand to the katana and most of his upper teeth to the flat of the blade. His replacement fingers are industrial salvage â€” thick, clumsy, meant for cargo work. His dental work is Tier 1 ceramic that doesn't match, giving him a checkerboard smile he refuses to show.

Rodney grew up in the Exclusion Zone between Gary and Hammond â€” the same ungoverned corridors Kyle survived as a child, though they never crossed paths. He has a daughter, Keisha (age 9), from a relationship that ended when the mother, Trina, relocated to the Milwaukee Zone. Rodney has not seen Keisha in two years. He sends messages. Keisha responds with single-word answers. He reads each one forty times.

Of all the crew, Rodney is the most likely to do something stupid and solo. He has the least to lose and the most anger. He went back to the loading dock the day after the Prologue and collected Kyle's spent shell casings. He keeps them in a jar on his shelf. He does not know why. He looks at them every night. They are the closest thing he has to a relationship with the man who broke him.

core_desires: To feel like he matters to someone
coping_mechanisms: Anger â€” it's the only emotion that doesn't require teeth to express
Planning solo revenge that will fail
blind_spots: Solo action against Kyle is suicide and he doesn't care enough to stop
The shell casings are not rage â€” they're grief, and he can't tell the difference
psychology.secret: He writes letters to Keisha that he never sends. They are in a box under his bed next to the jar of shell casings. The letters are gentle, funny, and well-written. Nobody in the crew would believe he wrote them.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Angry. Profane. Missing sibilants from the dental work. The lisp undercuts every threat.
speech_patterns.cadence: Spits words. Literally â€” the ceramic causes saliva issues.
verbal_tics: Gets louder when the lisp gets worse
example_lines: I'll find him. I'll *whistle* find him and I'll â€” THTOP LAUGHING.
Keitha thent me a mesthage. Thaid 'ok.' Jutht 'ok.' *pause* ...That'th enough.

relationships.name: Keisha Sisk
relationships.description: Nine years old. Milwaukee Zone. Single-word messages. Rodney's entire emotional landscape compressed into 'ok' and 'fine' and 'goodnight.'
relationships.emotional_core: Love that has no delivery mechanism
relationships.story_tension: If Rodney dies doing something stupid, Keisha's last message will have been 'ok.' Rodney knows this.

relationships.name: Trina
relationships.description: Relocated to Milwaukee. Does not prevent Keisha's messages. Does not encourage them.
relationships.story_tension: Trina left because Rodney was already angry. The crew made it worse. Kyle made it unbearable.

story_hooks: The shell casing jar is grief disguised as obsession
The unsent letters are the real Rodney
Most likely to make a solo move â€” most likely to die doing it
The lisp undercuts every threat â€” dark comedy that eventually becomes tragic
narrative_function: The angry one. Crank is pure frustrated rage without the hardware or intelligence to do anything with it. His solo revenge attempts will be recurring failures that escalate in ambition and comedy. The shell casing collection is either creepy or sad depending on the light.
augmentations: Three industrial salvage fingers (right hand). Tier 1 ceramic dental partial. Nothing else new.
daily_life: Being angry. Planning revenge. Practicing threats in the mirror. Whistling involuntarily.

stress.response: Erupts into loud sibilant rage that undercuts itself

decision_rules: If it involves hurting Kyle, do it regardless of odds
Never smile in public â€” the teeth are a humiliation
Read every message from Keisha at least forty times
Plan solo revenge missions even when they are obviously suicidal
Cover mouth when speaking to hide the lisp
Keep the shell casing jar maintained and visible
escalation_ladder: Loud profane threats undermined by the lisp
Solo action without informing the crew

interpersonal_modes.keisha: Desperate tenderness expressed only in unsent letters
interpersonal_modes.crew_members: Angry solidarity; loudest voice in any room, least effective
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Hostile defensiveness, especially about the teeth

stress_responses.low: Grumbling, pacing, practicing threats in the mirror
stress_responses.medium: Loud outbursts with increased whistling on sibilants
stress_responses.high: Retreats to the shell casing jar; stares at it for hours
stress_responses.critical: Goes solo â€” walks toward Kyle with no plan and maximum anger

contradictions: The shell casings are grief disguised as obsession and he cannot tell the difference
His unsent letters reveal a gentle articulate man the crew would never believe exists
Wants to be present for Keisha but keeps choosing actions that will get him killed
habits: Looks at the shell casing jar every night before sleeping
Writes letters to Keisha he never sends
Practices threats in the mirror, getting louder as the lisp worsens
Covers his mouth reflexively during conversation
Reads Keisha single-word messages dozens of times
breaking_points: Being laughed at for the lisp during a serious moment
Someone finding and reading his unsent letters
A genuine opportunity to face Kyle alone

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African (42.2%), South Asian (34.9%), and Hispanic/Latin American (22.9%) ancestry â€” a genetic mosaic reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora. The dominant Sub-Saharan ancestry grounds his deeper complexion and broader facial structure, while significant South Asian heritage contributes warmth and angular definition to his cheekbones and nose bridge. Hispanic/Latin American ancestry adds subtle warmth and facial width. His appearance is a true three-continent blend, weathered by dock labor and industrial exposure.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and thick through the chest, but lean in the arms and legs â€” the physique of dock labor, weathered and efficient rather than muscular. Carries tension in his shoulders.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, graying at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Short, cropped close, practical. No fade or shape â€” just clipped to regulation length every few weeks at a Tier 4 barbershop.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with warm amber undertones, slightly bloodshot from poor sleep
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones â€” the result of Sub-Saharan depth (42.2%), South Asian warmth (34.9%), and Hispanic sun-soaked heritage (22.9%) blending into a complexion weathered by humidity and industrial dust rather than direct exposure
physical_description.complexion: Broad nose bridge with angular cheekbones reflecting the South Asian and Sub-Saharan components of his ancestry, jaw clenched most of the time. Facial structure shows the width and definition characteristic of his mixed heritage. A thin scar runs from his left temple to his jawline â€” old, faded, unrelated to the Prologue. His face is scarred with anger; he looks perpetually on the edge of saying something he'll regret.
distinguishing_marks: Three fingers on right hand (index, middle, ring) are industrial salvage chrome and polymer â€” thick, blunt, painted matte gray, clearly not original. They move with a slight mechanical whine.
Upper left canine and bicuspid are mismatched Tier 1 ceramic â€” too white, slightly too large, creating a visible gap when he tightens his jaw.
Thin, pale scar running left temple to left jawline, approximately 12cm, pre-Prologue origin.
Burn mark on inside of right forearm, roughly 5cm diameter, circular â€” old accident with dock equipment, faded to pale pink.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right hand salvage fingers are immediately visible â€” industrial-grade, no attempt to disguise or blend with flesh. The dental partial is visible only when he grimaces or speaks with certain vowels. Scars visible on exposed skin. No other augmentations visible; any implants are subcutaneous and invisible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Hunched slightly forward, as if perpetually bracing for impact or leaning into work. His right hand (the salvage one) is held stiffly, claw-like, when at rest. He moves with purpose but without fluidity â€” economical, efficient, no wasted motion. His left hand fidgets constantly: rubbing his jaw, touching the jar in his pocket, balling into a fist. When standing still, he rocks slightly heel-to-toe, never truly at rest.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 dock worker uniform: reinforced canvas work pants with tool pockets, faded to a grimy gray. Steel-toed boots, scuffed and held together with epoxy and habit. A sleeveless compression vest (black, Tier 3 brand, worn under an oversized gray longshoreman's coat). The coat is missing one button. He wears no jewelry except a fraying cordage bracelet on his left wrist â€” a gift from Keisha, two years old, unwashed. His hands are perpetually stained with grease and rust. His clothes smell like diesel and desperation.
